correctness.rationale: The mixed-quadrant orbits have exact finite first-crossing times; unequal times enter invariant homogeneous quadrants. Equal times enter a forward-invariant alternating strip, hence converge to the explicit period-two orbit. Two independent uniform crossing variables give the squared-bin formula, and one-sided derivative signs at every power-of-two resonance yield strict cusps; a bounded last-bin variable gives the sharp 3/4 asymptotic. The exact-rational checker exercises the key finite identities and orbit classification.
